```{r setup}
source("utils.R")
source("config_flow.R")

PARADIGM    <- "active"
MEASURE     <- "raw"
LOCK        <- "stim"
DATE_SOURCE <- "20261015"
WINDOW      <- "350-750ms"
CHANNELS    <- c("Fz", "Pz")

OUTPUT_RESULTS <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/stats/flow/castellar/"
DATA_ROOT      <- "L:/EEG_Flow_data/Study_EEG_Flow_Active/derivatives_v2/outputs/measures/flow/"
DATE_STR       <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

dir.create(OUTPUT_RESULTS, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

n         <- length(INCLUDED_ACTIVE)
csv_fname <- glue("{DATE_SOURCE}_{PARADIGM}_{n}p_flow_stim_{MEASURE}_allch_allwin_meanamp.csv")
csv_path  <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, csv_fname)

df_all <- load_cluster_data(csv_path, CONDITION_MAP, INCLUDED_ACTIVE)
cat("Loaded:", nrow(df_all), "rows |", n_distinct(df_all$participant), "participants\n")
cat("Windows available:", paste(sort(unique(df_all$window)), collapse=", "), "\n")

summary_rows <- list()
apa_texts    <- list()
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
cat(glue(
"**Paper**: FLOW — à la Castellar  
**Paradigm**: ACTIVE  
**Window**: {WINDOW}  
**Electrodes**: {paste(CHANNELS, collapse=' × ')}  
**Conditions**: {paste(CONDITION_LEVELS, collapse=' vs ')}  
**N participants**: {n}  
**Rendered**: {DATE_STR}  
"))
```

```{r analysis-functions}
run_stim_analysis <- function(df_all, stim) {
  df_cond <- df_all %>%
    filter(
      stim    == !!stim,
      window  == WINDOW,
      ch_name %in% CHANNELS
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      ch_name   = factor(ch_name,   levels = CHANNELS),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = CONDITION_LEVELS)
    )

  if (nrow(df_cond) == 0) {
    cat(glue("> Warning: No data for stim='{stim}', window='{WINDOW}'\n\n"))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  n_valid <- n_distinct(df_cond$participant)
  cat(glue("N = {n_valid} participants\n\n"))

  # Boxplot
  p <- df_cond %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = ch_name, y = mean_amp_uv, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CONDITION_COLORS, name = "Condition") +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    labs(
      title    = glue("{str_to_title(stim)} — {WINDOW} | Fz × Pz"),
      subtitle = glue("N = {n_valid}"),
      x        = "Electrode",
      y        = "Mean amplitude (µV)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(p)
  cat("\n")

  # Assumption check
  res_aov <- aov(mean_amp_uv ~ ch_name * condition, data = df_cond)
  resids  <- residuals(res_aov)
  shapiro <- shapiro.test(resids)
  cat(glue("**Shapiro-Wilk** (residuals): W = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$statistic), 3)}, p = {round(as.numeric(shapiro$p.value), 3)}\n\n"))

  # Repeated-measures ANOVA
  res_ges <- anova_test(
    data = df_cond, dv = mean_amp_uv, wid = participant,
    within = c(ch_name, condition), type = 2, effect.size = "ges"
  )
  res_pes <- anova_test(
    data = df_cond, dv = mean_amp_uv, wid = participant,
    within = c(ch_name, condition), type = 2, effect.size = "pes"
  )
  tbl     <- get_anova_table(res_ges)
  tbl$pes <- get_anova_table(res_pes)$pes

  cat("**Repeated-measures ANOVA:**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(tbl, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")

  # Bayesian RM ANOVA
  df_cond_bf <- df_cond %>%
    mutate(participant = factor(participant),
           ch_name     = factor(ch_name),
           condition   = factor(condition))

  bf_models <- anovaBF(
    mean_amp_uv ~ ch_name * condition + participant,
    data        = df_cond_bf,
    whichRandom = "participant",
    whichModels = "withmain",
    progress    = FALSE
  )

  bf_df       <- as.data.frame(bf_models)
  bf_df$model <- rownames(bf_df)

  normalize_term <- function(term) {
    if (grepl(":", term)) {
      parts <- sort(trimws(strsplit(term, ":")[[1]]))
      paste(parts, collapse = ":")
    } else {
      trimws(term)
    }
  }

  get_bf_for_model <- function(target_terms) {
    target_norm <- sort(sapply(target_terms, normalize_term))
    terms_list  <- strsplit(bf_df$model, "\\s*\\+\\s*")
    matches     <- sapply(terms_list, function(terms) {
      setequal(sort(sapply(terms, normalize_term)), target_norm)
    })
    if (sum(matches) != 1) {
      warning(glue("Expected exactly 1 match for {paste(target_terms, collapse=', ')}, found {sum(matches)}"))
      return(NA)
    }
    bf_df$bf[matches]
  }

  bf_chname      <- get_bf_for_model(c("ch_name", "participant"))
  bf_condition   <- get_bf_for_model(c("condition", "participant"))
  bf_maineffects <- get_bf_for_model(c("ch_name", "condition", "participant"))
  bf_full        <- get_bf_for_model(c("ch_name", "condition", "ch_name:condition", "participant"))
  bf_interaction <- bf_full / bf_maineffects
  bf_lookup      <- c("ch_name" = bf_chname, "condition" = bf_condition, "ch_name:condition" = bf_interaction)

  # APA text — ANOVA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tbl))) {
    row    <- tbl[i, ]
    term   <- row$Effect
    f_val  <- round(row$F, 2)
    df1    <- row$DFn
    df2    <- row$DFd
    p_val  <- as.numeric(row$p)
    eta    <- round(as.numeric(row$pes), 3)
    p_str  <- format_p(p_val)
    bf_str <- if (term %in% names(bf_lookup)) format_bf(bf_lookup[[term]]) else "NA"
    apa    <- glue("{term}: F({df1}, {df2}) = {f_val}, {p_str}, pes = {eta}, BF10 = {bf_str}")
    cat(glue("- {apa}\n\n"))
    apa_texts[[glue("{stim}_{term}")]] <<- apa
  }
  cat("\n")

  # Post-hoc paired t-tests
  cat("**Post-hoc** (paired t-tests, Bonferroni):\n\n")
  posthoc <- df_cond %>%
    group_by(ch_name) %>%
    pairwise_t_test(
      mean_amp_uv ~ condition,
      paired          = TRUE,
      p.adjust.method = "bonferroni"
    )
  print(knitr::kable(posthoc, digits = 3))
  cat("\n")

  # Bayesian paired t-test per channel
  bf_by_channel <- map_dfr(unique(df_cond$ch_name), function(ch) {
    df_wide_ch <- df_cond %>%
      filter(ch_name == ch) %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = condition, values_from = mean_amp_uv) %>%
      drop_na(all_of(CONDITION_LEVELS))
    bf_res <- ttestBF(x = df_wide_ch[[CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]], y = df_wide_ch[[CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]], paired = TRUE)
    tibble(ch_name = ch, BF10 = as.numeric(extractBF(bf_res)$bf))
  })
  posthoc <- posthoc %>%
    left_join(bf_by_channel, by = "ch_name") %>%
    mutate(BF01 = 1 / BF10)

  # Post-hoc APA
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(posthoc))) {
    row   <- posthoc[i, ]
    ch    <- row$ch_name
    p_str <- format_p(as.numeric(row$p.adj))

    stats <- df_cond %>%
      filter(ch_name == ch) %>%
      group_by(condition) %>%
      summarise(M = round(mean(mean_amp_uv, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
                SD = round(sd(mean_amp_uv,  na.rm=TRUE), 2), .groups="drop")

    m1  <- stats$M[stats$condition  == CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]
    sd1 <- stats$SD[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[1]]
    m2  <- stats$M[stats$condition  == CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]
    sd2 <- stats$SD[stats$condition == CONDITION_LEVELS[2]]

    apa_ph <- glue(
      "{ch}: {CONDITION_LEVELS[1]} (M={m1}, SD={sd1}) vs ",
      "{CONDITION_LEVELS[2]} (M={m2}, SD={sd2}), ",
      "t({row$df}) = {round(row$statistic, 2)}, {p_str}, BF10 = {format_bf(row$BF10)}"
    )
    cat(glue("- {apa_ph}\n\n"))
    apa_texts[[glue("{stim}_{ch}_posthoc")]] <<- apa_ph
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Standard stimuli

```{r standard, results='asis'}
run_stim_analysis(df_all, "standard")
```

## Target stimuli

```{r target, results='asis'}
run_stim_analysis(df_all, "target")
```

## Novel stimuli

```{r novel, results='asis'}
run_stim_analysis(df_all, "novel")
```

## APA Text Block

*Ready to copy-paste into manuscript.*

```{r apa-block, results='asis'}
current_stim <- ""
for (label in names(apa_texts)) {
  stim_part <- strsplit(label, "_")[[1]][1]
  if (stim_part != current_stim) {
    current_stim <- stim_part
    cat(glue("\n**{str_to_title(stim_part)}**\n\n"))
  }
  cat(apa_texts[[label]], "\n\n")
}
```
